name: Lemon Squeezy
desc: Lemon Squeezy is a payment gateway for e-commerce and subscription-based businesses.

actions.name: list_products
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of products from your Lemon Squeezy store.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of orders from your Lemon Squeezy store, with optional filters.

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Retrieve the details of a specific order by its ID.

actions.name: list_subscriptions
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of subscriptions from your Lemon Squeezy store.

actions.name: create_checkout
actions.description: Create a checkout URL for a specific Lemon Squeezy product variant.

actions.name: list_customers
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of customers from your Lemon Squeezy store.

actions.name: list_stores
actions.description: List the stores your API key can access.

actions.name: get_customer
actions.description: Retrieve a customer by ID.

actions.name: find_customer_by_email
actions.description: Look up a customer by email address.

actions.name: create_customer
actions.description: Create a customer in a store.

actions.name: update_customer
actions.description: Update a customer's details or archive the customer.

actions.name: list_order_items
actions.description: List order items, filtered by order, product or variant.

actions.name: generate_order_invoice
actions.description: Generate a downloadable PDF invoice for an order.

actions.name: get_product
actions.description: Retrieve a product by ID.

actions.name: list_variants
actions.description: List product variants, optionally for one product.

actions.name: get_subscription
actions.description: Retrieve a subscription by ID.

actions.name: cancel_subscription
actions.description: Cancel a subscription at the end of its billing period.

actions.name: resume_subscription
actions.description: Undo a cancellation during the grace period.

actions.name: pause_subscription
actions.description: Pause payment collection for a subscription.

actions.name: unpause_subscription
actions.description: Resume payment collection on a paused subscription.

actions.name: change_subscription_plan
actions.description: Move a subscription to another variant (plan). This can charge the customer.

actions.name: list_subscription_invoices
actions.description: List subscription invoices (renewal payments).

actions.name: list_discounts
actions.description: List discount codes.

actions.name: create_discount
actions.description: Create a discount code in a store.

actions.name: delete_discount
actions.description: Permanently delete a discount code.

actions.name: get_license_key
actions.description: Retrieve a license key by ID or by the key itself.

actions.name: update_license_key
actions.description: Change a license key's activation limit, expiry or disabled state.

actions.name: list_license_keys
actions.description: List license keys, filtered by store, order or product.

actions.name: get_discount
actions.description: Retrieve a discount by ID.

actions.name: list_license_key_instances
actions.description: List the activations (instances) of license keys.

actions.name: list_affiliates
actions.description: List affiliates, optionally by store or email.

actions.name: list_discount_redemptions
actions.description: List the orders that used a discount.

actions.name: list_subscription_items
actions.description: List the price items (quantity, usage-based) of subscriptions.

actions.name: validate_license
actions.description: Check whether a license key is valid, without activating it.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: order_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new order is successfully placed

triggers.name: order_refunded
triggers.description: Triggers when a full or partial refund is made on an order

triggers.name: subscription_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new subscription is successfully created

triggers.name: subscription_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription's data is changed or updated

triggers.name: subscription_cancelled
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription is cancelled manually by the customer or store owner

triggers.name: subscription_resumed
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription is resumed after being previously cancelled

triggers.name: subscription_expired
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription has ended after being previously cancelled

triggers.name: subscription_paused
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription's payment collection is paused

triggers.name: subscription_unpaused
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription's payment collection is resumed after being previously paused

triggers.name: subscription_payment_success
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription payment is successful

triggers.name: subscription_payment_failed
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription renewal payment fails

triggers.name: subscription_payment_recovered
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription has a successful payment after a failed payment

triggers.name: subscription_payment_refunded
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription payment is refunded

triggers.name: license_key_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a license key is created from a new order

triggers.name: license_key_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a license key is updated

triggers.name: affiliate_activated
triggers.description: Triggers when an affiliate is activated
